title: Resolution urging Albany to extend tax breaks for HDFC co-ops
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.2707B/S.880B, the housing development fund company fairness, preservation and affordability act. The bill would extend in perpetuity a tax exemption for income-restricted HDFC cooperatives set to expire in 2029 and offer a new tax abatement option. It would also let the city forgive tax arrears for HDFCs that agree to greater oversight, affecting roughly 1,048 HDFC co-ops with about 25,000 apartments and 75,000 residents citywide.
